items.anchor_event: occurrence of such event of Force Majeure
items.description: Either party may terminate immediately without liability if normal performance cannot be resumed within the stated period after a Force Majeure event.

items.description: Client must give Host 75 days' notice before the end of the Initial Term to request an extension of the Term.

items.span_text: Host will notify Client of the proposed new Operations Service Fees no later than 75 days before the end of the Initial Period or relevant Holdover Period.

items.description: Either party may terminate on 30 days' written notice if a party undergoes a change of Control.
items.span_text: Should a Party undergo a change of Control, either Party has the right to terminate this Agreement by giving the other Party 30-days written notice of termination.
